body: Follow-up source review of accepted result6b02b287 / product2cc48419. The handoff explicitly admits a claimed presentation that never attaches remains blocked forever, and testAppearingCancelledClaimDoesNotInferDetachFromMissingWindow codifies recovery only via parent loss. This does not yet satisfy the previously required claimed-but-appearing liveness. Please independently trace actual SwiftUI content claim, NSView window/probe attach/detach, dismantle and onDismiss lifecycle and propose/implement a narrow terminal ownership signal for cancelled-before-attachment claims. Missing capture alone must not be treated as detached, but a completed dismissal must not require closing the document window to recover. Also check probe/didBegin/didEnd ordering where probe first reports after parent already detached: current observedAttachment false would ignore later termination. Prefer explicit captured native/view ownership and terminal lifecycle evidence, no sleep/poll/time guesses, no forced ending unrelated sheets. Add deterministic preattachment cancel then successor regression with legitimate terminal signals and native event-order coverage. Source-only as before, separate test/product commits, no B builds/apps/tests/heartbeat changes. If existing framework semantics rule out either sequence, provide precise local/API evidence rather than assuming it. Preserve 2cc source and prior validations; A has not compiled it yet, current full recovery failed2 assertions/589 and is receiving a separate Layers selection fix.
